career_ladder.salary_growth_trajectory: Recruitment through the Meghalaya Police Central Recruitment Board (MLPRB) selects personnel for both executive Sub-Inspector and Constable cadres. Constables (Unarmed Branch, Armed Branch, Fireman, MPRO Operator) enter at Meghalaya Services (ROP) Rules 2018 Level 3 (₹20,600 – ₹47,000), while directly recruited Sub-Inspectors enter at Level 11 (₹37,800 – ₹86,400). Constables advance through competitive departmental promotion examinations and seniority to Head Constable (Level 5, ₹26,000 – ₹59,000), Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI, Level 8, ₹30,300 – ₹69,200), Sub-Inspector of Police (SI, Level 11, ₹37,800 – ₹86,400), Inspector of Police (Level 15, ₹47,600 – ₹1,08,200), and Gazetted Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP, Level 16, ₹53,100 – ₹1,20,800) in the Meghalaya Police Service (MPS).

official_perks.description: Dearness Allowance at 58% of Basic Pay (₹11,948 per month on entry basic of ₹20,600 as of 01.07.2025) as notified by Finance Department, Government of Meghalaya.
HRA at 8% of Basic Pay (₹1,648 per month) in Shillong and other district headquarters, or rent-free police barrack/family quarter accommodation.
Compensatory hill allowance and winter heating allowance admissible to police personnel stationed in the Khasi, Jaintia, and Garo hills.
Monthly ration money subsidy and uniform washing allowance (approx ₹2,000 per month) under Meghalaya Police Service Regulations.
Coverage under National Pension System (NPS with 14% matching employer contribution) and Meghalaya Health Insurance Scheme (MHIS).
